title: kargo.toml
description: The manifest of a Kargo package or workspace. See https://enekocm7.github.io/kargo/reference/manifest/

package.description: The package's name, version and publishing details.

version.description: The package version; names the jar and is the version in its Maven coordinates. `{ workspace = true }` inherits [workspace.package].

group.description: Maven group, also the base Kotlin package in templates. Required to publish.

description.description: One sentence about the package (POM <description>). Required by Maven Central.

license.description: An SPDX expression such as `MIT` or `MIT OR Apache-2.0`. Required by Maven Central.

homepage.description: The project's web page, an http(s) URL. Defaults to `repository`.

repository.description: The source repository, an http(s) URL. Required by Maven Central.

version.description: Kotlin compiler and standard library version.

opt-in.description: Annotations to opt in to everywhere.

toolchain.description: Which JDK builds and runs the project.

jdk.description: "system" (JAVA_HOME or java on PATH), a major version such as "21", or an exact Temurin release such as "21.0.5+11".

target.description: The targets to build. Without it the project targets the JVM with default settings.

jvm-target.description: Java bytecode version: 8 (or 1.8), or 9 and up. Defaults to 25, lowered to the JDK that builds the project.

main-class.description: The JVM main class. Default: detected from a Kotlin `fun main`.

jvm-args.description: JVM options for `kargo run` and `kargo test`.

javac-args.description: Extra javac options for Java sources.

dependencies.description: Dependencies of the JVM target only.

environment.description: `js` for Node.js, `browser` for web pages, `wasi` for WASI runtimes.

kind.description: `application` for a program with a `main`, `library` for an npm package of @JsExport functions.

module-name.description: Name of the compiled module's files (`<name>.mjs`, `<name>.wasm`). Default: the package name.

npm-name.description: `name` in the package.json of a library. Default: the lowercase package name.

package-manager.description: The tool that installs npm packages. Default: the first of npm, pnpm, bun on PATH.

wasm-opt.description: Run Binaryen's wasm-opt in release builds: true (when on PATH), false, or the path of the executable.

npm-dependencies.description: npm packages (`name = "version"`) to install besides those the klibs ask for.

dependencies.description: Dependencies of the Wasm target only.

platforms.description: Kotlin/Native platforms to build for. Gradle-style names like `linuxX64` are accepted too.

entry-point.description: The Kotlin/Native entry function. Default: the single `main` in the sources.

cinterop.description: C libraries bound with cinterop, one table per library.

def.description: The .def file, relative to the project root. Default: interop/<name>.def.

package.description: Kotlin package of the generated bindings.

compiler-options.description: clang options for reading the headers.

linker-options.description: Linker options recorded in the bindings.

dependencies.description: Dependencies of the Native target only.

android.description: Build for Android (through a generated Gradle project).

gradle-version.description: Gradle version that runs the build. Default: the minimum `agp-version` requires.

minify.description: Shrink, obfuscate and optimize release builds with R8.

shrink-resources.description: Remove unused resources from release builds. Needs `minify`. Default: `minify`, for applications.

proguard-files.description: ProGuard/R8 rule files for release builds, relative to the project root.

consumer-proguard-files.description: ProGuard/R8 rules a library ships to the apps that use it (libraries only).

signing.description: Signing configurations by build type. Passwords come from environment variables.

flavor-dimensions.description: The order of the flavor dimensions; required when the flavors use more than one.

dimension.description: The flavor dimension this flavor belongs to.

dependencies.description: Dependencies of the Android target only.

bin.description: Named programs besides the default one, run with `kargo run --bin <name>`.

name.description: Letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter; unique.

path.description: A .kt file, relative to the project root, that declares exactly one `main`.

dev-dependencies.description: Dependencies used only to compile and run tests.

repositories.description: Maven repositories besides Maven Central: a URL, "maven-local", or a table with credentials.

url.description: An http(s):// or file: URL, or "maven-local".

username-env.description: Environment variable holding the user name.

password-env.description: Environment variable holding the password or token.

env.description: Variables for `kargo run`, `kargo test`, tasks and hooks. See `kargo env`.

profile.description: Build profiles: `dev` and `release`, and custom ones such as `[profile.staging]` that build with `--profile staging`.

includes.description: Markdown files with module and package documentation.

source-link.description: http(s) URL of the project root in a code browser.

external-links.description: http(s) roots of Dokka or Javadoc sites to link dependency types to.

config.description: detekt configuration files, relative to the project root.

baseline.description: Baseline file, relative to the project root.

fail-fast.description: Stop at the first target whose tests fail.

timeout.description: How long the whole test run may take, such as "30s", "5m" or "1h". The run is stopped when it passes.

test-timeout.description: How long one JVM test may take, such as "30s" or "2m" (JUnit Jupiter's default timeout).

jvm-args.description: JVM arguments for the test process, after [target.jvm] jvm-args.

repository.description: Where `kargo publish` publishes without --repository: maven-central, maven-local or a [repositories] entry.

sign.description: Sign every file with GnuPG (default: true for Maven Central).

central-publishing.description: What Maven Central does with a validated upload.

workspace.description: A workspace: its kargo.toml has only this table, no [package].

members.description: Directories of the member packages, relative to this file, or globs such as "libs/*". `kargo new <dir>` inside the workspace adds new members.

exclude.description: Directories that `members` globs must not match.

default-members.description: The members that `kargo build` and the other commands work on at the workspace root (default: every member).

kotlin.description: Kotlin settings of every member. A member's own `opt-in` and `compiler-args` add to these; its other [kotlin] keys take precedence.

version.description: The Kotlin version of every member.

dependencies.description: Entries members inherit with `name = { workspace = true }`.

frameworks.description: Entries members inherit with `name = { workspace = true }` in [frameworks].

plugins.description: Entries members inherit with `name = { workspace = true }` in [plugins].

tasks.description: Tasks run at the workspace root with `kargo <task>`; members inherit them with `name = { workspace = true }` in [tasks].

inherit.description: Inherit this key from the workspace's kargo.toml.

frameworks.description: Built-in frameworks: each adds libraries, compiler plugins and flags. In a member, `name = { workspace = true }` inherits the entry of [workspace.frameworks].

coroutines.description: kotlinx.coroutines: true, false or a version string.

json.description: Add ktor-serialization-kotlinx-json (default: when serialization is enabled).

config.description: Path to lombok.config, relative to the project root.

jpa.description: Apply the JPA no-arg preset (default: when `data-jpa` is a starter).

id.description: The compiler plugin id, for its options.

workspace.description: In a member: inherit the plugin of the same name from [workspace.plugins] (alone, without other keys).

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the project root.

workspace.description: In a member: inherit the task of the same name from [workspace.tasks] (alone, without other keys).

android-build-config.description: `BuildConfig` fields: a string becomes a `String`, a boolean a `boolean`, an integer an `int` (or `long`).

android-signing.description: The keystore that signs this build type.

store-file.description: The keystore, relative to the project root.

store-password-env.description: Environment variable holding the keystore password.

key-alias.description: The alias of the key in the keystore.

key-password-env.description: Environment variable holding the key password. Default: `store-password-env`.

dependencies.description: Keys are `group:artifact`, a package name (with `path`) or any name (with `group`/`coords`).

version.description: Version or Maven range. Optional when a BOM manages it.

group.description: Maven group when the key isn't `group:artifact`.

artifact.description: Artifact id; defaults to the key.

force.description: Use this version even if a newer one is requested.

path.description: Directory of another Kargo package to build from source; only `scope`, `exported` and `test-fixtures` can be set with it.

exported.description: Part of this package's API: packages that depend on it through `path` compile against it too, and its POM scope is `compile`. Otherwise they only get it at runtime.

test-fixtures.description: With `path`, in [dev-dependencies]: also use the dependency's test fixtures (`test-fixtures/`).

workspace.description: Inherit the entry of the same name from [workspace.dependencies]; only `scope`, `exported` and `test-fixtures` can be added.

commands.description: A command or a list of commands.

env.description: Variables for the program: a string, or a table with `value`, `force`, `relative` or `required`. Also `env-files` and `expose`.

env-files.description: More `.env` files, relative to the package root, read after the standard ones. `--no-env-file` skips them.

expose.description: Variables compiled into a generated `BuildConfig` object, for the JVM, Native and Wasm (Node.js) targets.

profile-env.description: Variables that replace `[env]` for this profile, variable by variable. Also `env-files`.

env-files.description: More `.env` files for this profile, relative to the package root.

force.description: Use `value` even when the shell or a `.env` file sets the variable.

required.description: Fail before anything runs unless the shell or a `.env` file sets the variable.

inherits.description: The profile this one starts from: `dev` (the default), `release` or another custom profile. Not for `dev` and `release`.

compiler-args.description: Extra compiler arguments for this profile.

jvm-args.description: JVM options for `kargo run` and `kargo test`, after `[target.jvm] jvm-args`.

dependencies.description: Dependencies only this profile's builds have.
